neighbours.label: degree/conditional framing connectives: 'insofar', 'to the extent', 'according to', 'depending on' (the scope-limiting word)
fire: The rules apply only insofar as they concern public land.
To the extent that funds allow, the library will extend its hours.
Prices vary depending on the season and the room size.
Players are ranked according to their total points.
Insofar as the evidence goes, the bridge was safe.
The tool is useful to the extent that users trust it.
Depending on traffic, the trip takes two or three hours.
Fees are charged according to the weight of the parcel.
quiet: The rules apply only because they concern public land.
Because funds are short, the library will cut its hours.
Prices are high in summer and the rooms are small.
Players are ranked after every match this season.
Although the evidence is thin, the bridge was safe.
The tool is useful although many users distrust it.
Even with light traffic, the trip takes two or three hours.
Fees are charged when the parcel is weighed.

notes: Card: peaks on 'sofar' (Insofar as), ' extent' (To the extent), ' to' (according to), ' Depending', 'biais' (Par le biais). Near misses use causal or concessive connectives in the same frames.
